title: My Cozy Vibe Coded Game
author: Kulimar
selftext:
Worked on this for a few hours on the Easter weekend using o3 and o4. Will likely continue to iterate on it when o3-Pro drops so I can get longer context updates.

[https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aRfaCW9s9U0](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=aRfaCW9s9U0)

comments.author: Downtown-Spare-822
comments.body: Very nice!  Is the pixel art also done with AI tools or hand drawn?  Or, the gameplay is coded with o3/o4?

replies.author: Mean_Establishment31
replies.body: made with the gpt 4o image generator. All code from o3.

replies.author: Kulimar
replies.body:
It's finding a valid path within the limited number of clicks with some light time pressure. Starts easy, but gets harder as the board expands. You can highlight over tiles in advance to scout for an optimal path.

It is just a simple logic puzzle. Just something relaxing to do. I play it just to take a break sometimes.
